EX4-SQL-1: UPDATE ANNONCE SET PrixVente = PrixVente * 0.9 WHERE ImmatVeh IN (SELECT ImmatVeh FROM VEHICULE WHERE PuisFisc >= 6);
EX4-SQL-3: SELECT DISTINCT NomMod FROM MODELE M JOIN VEHICULE V ON M.IdMod = V.IdMod JOIN ANNONCE A ON V.ImmatVeh = A.ImmatVeh WHERE Energie = 'D' AND PrixVente <= 50000;
EX4-SQL-4: SELECT IdMod, COUNT(*) AS NbAnnonces FROM VEHICULE V JOIN ANNONCE A ON V.ImmatVeh = A.ImmatVeh GROUP BY IdMod;
